content.caption: Grouped bar chart of WebArena-Shopping success rates for four memory mechanisms under MaTTS (k = 5), comparing Pass@1 and Best-of-5 bars with a dashed no-scaling baseline.
content.description: Grouped bar chart with y-axis 'Success Rate (SR)' from 35 to 60. Four categories on the x-axis: No Memory, Synapse, AWM, ReasoningBank. Each category has a pink Pass@1 bar and a blue Best-of-5 bar, plus a gray circle marker on a dashed line representing No Scaling. Values: No Memory: Pass@1 39.0, Best-of-5 42.2, No Scaling 39.0. Synapse: 41.2, 44.4, 40.6. AWM: 45.5, 47.6, 44.4. ReasoningBank: 53.0, 55.1, 49.7. ReasoningBank achieves the highest values and the largest gain from scaling.
